units.source_text: 少纳言对她说：“今年您总得稍稍大人模样些才好。

en.t: Shonagon said to her, "This year you really must try to seem a little more grown-up.

units.source_text: 过了十岁的人，玩玩偶是不像样的。

en.t: Once someone is past ten years old, it is unseemly to play with dolls.

units.source_text: 您已经有了丈夫，见丈夫时总得像个夫人那样斯文一脉才是。

en.t: You already have a husband, so when you see him you should always behave gracefully, like a proper lady.

units.source_text: 您现在梳头发也不耐烦……”

en.t: Yet now you are even impatient about having your hair combed..."

units.source_text: 此时紫姬正在热衷于弄玩偶，少纳言对她说这话，意欲使她知道难为情。

en.t: At that moment Lady Murasaki was absorbed in playing with dolls, and Shonagon said this to make her feel ashamed.

units.source_text: 紫姬听了，心中想道：“如此说来，我已经有了丈夫了。

en.t: When Lady Murasaki heard it, she thought to herself, "Now that she says so, I already have a husband.

units.source_text: 少纳言她们的丈夫，样子都很难看；我却有这么漂亮的一个青年丈夫。”

en.t: The husbands of Shonagon and the others are all quite unattractive, but I have such a handsome young husband."

units.source_text: 这时候她才分明知道她和公子的关系。

en.t: Only then did she clearly understand her relationship with the young lord.

units.source_text: 虽然还很孩子气，毕竟总是年龄渐长的表示。

en.t: Though she was still very childish, this was nevertheless a sign that she was gradually growing older.

units.source_text: 紫姬这种孩子气模样，随处显露出来。

en.t: This childish side of Lady Murasaki showed itself everywhere.

units.source_text: 因此殿内的人也都看到，大家觉得这对夫妻很奇怪，

en.t: Because of this, everyone in the residence saw it too, and they all found this married couple very strange,

units.source_text: 然而谁也没有想到他们还只是有名无实的夫妻。

en.t: yet no one imagined that they were still husband and wife in name only.
